summary_ja: この告示を平成27年4月1日から適用し、各告示の表（注2）②等の改正規定は同年3月31日から適用する。
summary_en: Provides that this Public Notice applies from April 1, 2015, with certain amending provisions in the bank, bank holding company, shinkin bank, credit cooperative and Ultimate Designated Parent Company notices applying from March 31, 2015.
paragraphs: This Public Notice applies from April 1, 2015; provided, however, that the following apply from March 31 of the same year: the provisions amending Article 79-2, paragraph (3), item (i), (b), table, Note 2, ② and Article 284, table, Note 2 of the standards for determining whether the capital adequacy status of a bank is appropriate in light of the assets, etc. held by the bank, based on the provisions of Article 14-2 of the Banking Act in Article 1; the provisions amending Article 57-2, paragraph (3), item (i), (b), table, Note 2, ② and Article 262, table, Note 2 of the standards for determining whether the capital adequacy status of a bank holding company and its subsidiaries is appropriate in light of the assets, etc. held by them, based on the provisions of Article 52-25 of the Banking Act in Article 2; the provisions amending Article 74, paragraph (3), item (i), (b), table, Note 2, ② and Article 284, table, Note 2 of the standards for determining whether the capital adequacy status of a shinkin bank and a federation of shinkin banks is appropriate in light of the assets, etc. held by them, based on the provisions of Article 14-2 of the Banking Act as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 89, paragraph (1) of the Shinkin Bank Act in Article 3; the provisions amending Article 51, paragraph (3), item (i), (b), table, Note 2, ② of the standards for determining whether the capital adequacy status of a credit cooperative and a federation of credit cooperatives is appropriate in light of the assets, etc. held by them, based on the provisions of Article 14-2 of the Banking Act as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 6, paragraph (1) of the Act on Financial Businesses by Cooperatives in Article 4; and the provisions amending Article 47, paragraph (1), item (ii), (b), table, Note 2, ② and Article 262, table, Note 2 of the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy Status of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of the Assets, etc. Held by Such Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. in Article 7.
